1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.c3 Nf6 4.Be2 Nc6 5.d4.strategy: Recaptures with the c-pawn and completes the pawn centre that White has aimed at since c3. The open c-file belongs to both sides, and the pawn on e4 still needs watching.

Grabs the e4 pawn with the king still in the centre. White's d5 at once hits the knight on c6, with Qa4+ in the air along the open diagonal, so Black has to be exact, and the knight on e4 is far from its friends. A risky gambit.
1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.c3 Nf6 4.Be2 Nc6 5.d4.name: Sicilian Defence: Delayed Alapin Variation, Basman-Palatnik Gambit
